SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q11. Study the data given below and answer the question: 
Country 
Gross National Income (GNI) per capita (2017) 
Sri Lanka 
11,326 
India 
6,353 
Pakistan 
5,331 
Nepal 
2,471 
 
Which country has the highest standard of living according to the data?  
(A) India  
(B) Nepal  
(C) Sri Lanka  
(D) Pakistan

Answer / Solution:
Which country has the highest standard of living according to the data? 
(C) Sri Lanka 
Reasoning: Sri Lanka has the highest GNI per capita (11,326) in the given 
table.
